neighbours.label: the second half of a few set word pairs, whatever the topic: 'passer(s)' / 'passersby', 'free throw(s)', and a number plus '-point' or '-pointer' (three-point, two-pointer); not 'throw', 'point' or 'pass' on their own
fire: Several passersby stopped to watch the street musician tune his violin.
She sank both free throws with two seconds left on the clock.
His three-point shot from the corner tied the game.
A few curious passers-by peered into the bakery window.
The coach made the team practice free throws for an hour after school.
He hit a two-pointer just before the halftime buzzer.
The council approved a five-point plan to repair the old bridge.
Not a single passerby noticed the small dog waiting by the gate.
quiet: Several people stopped to watch the street musician tune his violin.
She tossed the ball back to her teammate with two seconds left on the clock.
His long shot from the corner tied the game.
A few curious shoppers peered into the bakery window.
The coach made the team practice passing for an hour after school.
He scored a basket just before the halftime buzzer.
The council approved a detailed plan to repair the old bridge.
Not a single neighbor noticed the small dog waiting by the gate.

predictions: most fire sentences above 0.3; near misses near 0; the five-point plan is the weakest fire case
